name: Cancer
shortDescription:
RoMIUS Urology provides expert, compassionate care for women diagnosed with urologic cancers. Although kidney and bladder cancers are less common in women than men, they often present differently and may be diagnosed later. Our team prioritizes timely evaluation, advanced diagnostics, and multidisciplinary treatment planning to ensure women receive the highest level of care throughout Northwest and West Central Ohio.
We partner closely with medical oncology, radiation oncology, imaging specialists, and primary care providers to deliver seamless, comprehensive cancer care from diagnosis through survivorship.
body:
Kidney Cancer in Women

Kidney cancer can affect women of all ages and often presents with symptoms such as flank pain, blood in the urine, or incidental findings on imaging.

RoMIUS Urology offers:

Advanced Diagnostic Evaluation

  • High-resolution CT or MRI
  • Urinalysis and laboratory testing
  • Ultrasound for surveillance or follow-up

State-of-the-Art Treatment Options

Our surgeons are regional leaders in:

  • Robotic partial nephrectomy (nephron-sparing surgery)
  • Robotic radical nephrectomy for advanced disease
  • Ablative therapies for select small lesions
  • Active surveillance for low-risk tumors

We emphasize kidney preservation whenever safely possible, particularly important for women with long life expectancy or underlying health concerns.

Multidisciplinary Collaboration

For advanced or metastatic kidney cancer, we work closely with medical oncology to coordinate immunotherapy and targeted systemic treatments, ensuring each patient receives an individualized and effective care plan.

Bladder Cancer in Women

Bladder cancer in women can sometimes be misdiagnosed initially as recurrent UTIs or bladder irritation, delaying detection. RoMIUS Urology focuses on early identification and timely management to optimize outcomes.

Comprehensive Evaluation & Testing

  • In-office cystoscopy
  • Urinalysis and culture
  • Urine cytology for cancer detection
  • CT urogram or ultrasound imaging

Cutting-Edge Intravesical Therapy

We offer the most advanced intravesical treatments, including:

  • Immunotherapy (e.g., BCG)
  • Chemotherapy instillations
  • Risk-based maintenance protocols

These therapies are tailored to the tumor grade, stage, and recurrence pattern.

Advanced Surgical Expertise

For more complex or muscle-invasive disease, our team performs:

  • Robotic radical cystectomy
  • Urinary reconstruction options tailored to each patient
  • Coordination with medical and radiation oncology

Women receive a highly personalized plan addressing cancer control, quality of life, urinary function, and long-term surveillance.

Why Women Trust RoMIUS Urology

  • Expertise in female urologic cancers
  • Fast evaluation of symptoms like hematuria or recurrent UTIs
  • Access to cutting-edge minimally invasive and robotic surgery
  • Advanced intravesical therapies for bladder cancer
  • Collaborative care with oncology and imaging specialists
  • Clear communication and compassionate support
  • Long-term surveillance to ensure early detection of recurrence
